state.description: Risk concentration — the Herfindahl index of each name's share of the portfolio's Total VaR — across every scenario set on the latest filing. 1/HHI ≈ the effective number of independent risk bets. The historical/event sets read diversified (Market dominates, HHI ≈ 0.03); the Hypo:* style-shock sets zero Market and collapse risk onto the few names carrying those tilts, so HHI jumps to ~0.18–0.21.
